name: Alabama AHSAA State Cross Country Championships
where: Moulton, AL · Oakville Indian Mounds Park
headline: Alabama AHSAA State Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Hoover won the 6A boys title with 48 points over Huntsville (78) as Hazel Green’s Nehemiah Johnson won in 15:24.33, and Hewitt-Trussville edged Hoover 62-67 for the 6A girls title, with Hoover’s Reese Gonzalez winning in 17:56.08.
